title: CarGurus Dealer | Upcoming Update to Instant Market Value
summary: Instant Market Value will reflect total advertised price
body_markdown:
##### **Why is CarGurus changing how IMV is calculated?**


We’re updating IMV to reflect the all-in advertised price, including applicable dealer fees, giving you a clearer view of how your inventory compares with similar local listings. It also helps shoppers compare vehicles with confidence and builds trust earlier in the shopping journey. This update is the next step in the price transparency plans[we announced in June.](https://dealers.cargurus.com/blog/fee-transparency-update?utm_source=Marketo&utm_medium=Email&utm_campaign=MarketoEmailAllInPriceUpdateUSNov2026&pid=MarketoEmailAllInPriceUpdateUSNov2026)


##### **Is CarGurus setting my prices?**


No. You continue to control your pricing and fees. IMV and Deal Ratings provide market context by showing how your advertised price compares with similar inventory; they do not tell you what price to charge.


##### **Why should I disclose my fees?**


Clear fee information helps shoppers understand the advertised price before they contact or visit your dealership which builds trust earlier and attracts buyers who are more informed and ready to act. As of July 14, used listings without disclosed fees receive a “No Rating” price analysis and move lower in search results. If you haven’t submitted your fees, setup takes less than five minutes in Dashboard → Settings → Dealer Fee Setup.


##### **We already disclosed our fees. Do we need to do anything?**


Thank you for helping us promote trust and transparency on our platform. No further action is needed. The IMV update will apply automatically across CarGurus on December 9.


##### **We don’t charge dealer or document fees. What should I do?**


Toggle off ‘My dealership charges dealer or document fees’ in your Dashboard. That helps ensure your listings have the right pricing information for shoppers and pricing analysis.


##### **What if my Deal Rating changes?**


A rating may change when applicable fees are included because the listing is being compared using a more complete advertised price. That is intended to create a fairer, more apples-to-apples comparison with similar inventory.


##### **Could this make my vehicles look less competitive?**


It may change how some listings compare, because the price shoppers see online is being used more consistently. That clearer comparison can help you identify where pricing, fees, or inventory strategy may create an opportunity.


##### **Why include fees, but not taxes, title, and registration?**


IMV and Deal Ratings will use applicable dealer or document fees that affect the advertised price. Government fees—including taxes, title, and registration—remain excluded. CarGurus does not provide legal advice. Please consult your own counsel regarding applicable laws and compliance obligations.


##### **Is this a compliance requirement?**


CarGurus is making pricing information more consistent so shoppers can compare listings with greater confidence. CarGurus does not provide legal advice, so you should consult your own counsel about applicable laws and compliance obligations.


##### **What happens if I do nothing?**


If your fees are already disclosed, nothing is required. Listings without disclosed fees will be categorized as “No Rating” and will move lower in search results. Adding or confirming your fee information helps ensure your listings are evaluated using the right advertised price.


##### **How do we track dealer compliance with fees?**


We have a robust Trust & Safety process that monitors compliance with CarGurus Pricing Policy using sophisticated AI tools and careful human evaluation. We evaluate dealer disclaimers, mismatches between advertised prices and consumer feedback and more.
